rows.observation: geo.json逐面/盒式UV解析至真实GeoVertex消费的一条独立烘焙机制，不能按6面、90/180/270旋转、mirror或38个示例cube分计。完整读取BakedModelFactory、GeoQuad、UVUnion、UVFaces、FaceUV和加载/缓存方法；实际GeckoArmorRenderer示例模型映射，读取gecko_armor.geo.json描述和头部前110行：64x64描述、bipedHead→armorHead父子、显式6面uv/uv_size、底面负V和右侧附属件负U、零宽eye平面。解析统计38cube均逐面只是结构核对，不算38参考或视觉验收。UVUnion以对象/数组选择逐面/盒式；buildQuad对缺失face直接return null，逐面把UV尺寸与Rotation传GeoQuad.build；盒式按floor(cube.size)分配六面网，DOWN尺寸负Z；二者均使用model description的textureWidth/Height归一化，不读取PNG实际尺寸。GeoQuad最终重载先求(u+uSize)/texWidth和(v+vSize)/texHeight，再归一化u/v；非mirror交换U端点，mirror改法线X；rotateUvs对四角做离散置换，GeoVertex.withUVs新建记录并保留position引用。VertexSet按direction及boxUv/mirror选几何面，逐面mirror会交换上下几何面，boxUv不会。constructCube先把几何origin转换X/16、inflate/16并建立vertices，UV仍依原像素cube.size，不能把inflation当纹理面自动增长。实际GeckoLibCache.loadModels→FileLoader/GEO_GSON注册→GeometryTree→Builtin.constructGeoModel/constructBone/constructCube→buildQuads/buildQuad；GeoModel.getBakedModel实际读cache，GeoRenderer.getBakedModel后renderCube/createVerticesOfQuad消费texU/texV。与已有DarknessArmorModel单纯texOffs建模、Tetra ShieldModelPartData薄CubeListBuilder包装不同，本处读取并追到自身真实UV四角构造，不靠引擎黑箱；与本轮发光像素搬移无重叠算法。限制：model只取minecraftGeometry[0]，不遍历多geometry；数组最小长度没有保障，JsonUtil缺失数组给3个零但传入短数组不补齐；纹理描述为0会除零，无UV范围clamp，负尺寸本身合法但不证明不越界。Rotation.fromValue按(value%360)/90整除，非90倍数被截断，负值部分被取绝对值递归纠正，不能称严格校验。GeoQuad修改传入四角数组元素，不能据此宣称共享模型线程安全；constructCube只以cube.mirror取boolean，不能声称继承bone mirror已实现。模型dimensions/pivot/方向约定与vanilla不同，不能直接把PNG按原版盔甲UV贴入自定义模型。未下载参考PNG、未运行Java/游戏、不声称加载或穿戴视觉通过。只归equipment_uv技术池1，不给28套盔甲各自加计，也不充学校武器/纹章1000门槛。

contextEvidence.source:
public static final Gson GEO_GSON = new GsonBuilder().setLenient()
			.registerTypeAdapter(Bone.class, Bone.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(Cube.class, Cube.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(FaceUV.class, FaceUV.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(LocatorClass.class, LocatorClass.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(LocatorValue.class, LocatorValue.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(MinecraftGeometry.class, MinecraftGeometry.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(Model.class, Model.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(ModelProperties.class, ModelProperties.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(PolyMesh.class, PolyMesh.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(PolysUnion.class, PolysUnion.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(TextureMesh.class, TextureMesh.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(UVFaces.class, UVFaces.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(UVUnion.class, UVUnion.deserializer())
			.registerTypeAdapter(Animation.Keyframes.class, new KeyFramesAdapter())
			.registerTypeAdapter(BakedAnimations.class, new BakedAnimationsAdapter())
			.create();
